title: Hipo.ro Scraper: Jobs in Romania for Students
description: Scrape job ads from Hipo.ro, the Romanian job board for students and young professionals: title, company, cities, hybrid or remote, salary when shown and, on request, the full text and apply info. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# Hipo.ro Jobs Scraper Scrape job ads from Hipo.ro ([hipo.ro](https://www.hipo.ro/)), the Romanian job board for students and young professionals. You get the title, company, cities, hybrid or remote, the salary when the ad shows one, the update date and the "apply without CV" badge for every ad. Turn on the job page option to add the domains, job type, experience level, the description sections (requirements, responsibilities, benefits, other information) as HTML and text, and the apply info. Narrow the search by domain, city and experience level. ## What you get - One row per ad, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, with currency, net or gross, and period) and a clean ISO date. - Optional job page details: all description sections as HTML and plain text, requirements, responsibilities, benefits as a list, domains, job type, experience level, the posting date, weekly hours and the apply buttons. - Each ad once per run. - A run with no input returns 20 ads for the experience level Manager. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/hipo-ro-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `hipo-ro-jobs-scraper` to find up to 50 jobs in the field IT-Software in the city Cluj-Napoca for the experience level "1 - 5 ani experienta". Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "experienceLevels": [ "Manager" ], "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 20 } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `domains` | Fields of work, for example IT-Software, IT-Hardware, Marketing, Vanzari, Inginerie, Banci, Contabilitate-Finante or Internship. Spaces or hyphens and any letter case work. Several values are read in one search. | | `cities` | Cities, for example BUCURESTI, Cluj-Napoca, Timisoara, Iasi, Brasov or Strainatate (abroad). Names with or without accents work. Several values are read in one search. | | `experienceLevels` | Student/Absolvent, 0 - 1 an experienta, 1 - 5 ani experienta, peste 5 ani experienta or Manager. Short forms such as student, 0-1, 1-5, 5+ and manager work. Several values are read in one search. | | `maxResults` | Ads in total. Default 200. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. The price per ad stays the same. | A filter value that the site does not know is skipped with a warning. When none of the values of a filter is known, the run ends with "0 jobs found" and nothing is charged. No filter at all reads the newest ads of the whole site. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "271987", "title": "Editor imagine TV Junior", "job_url": "https://www.hipo.ro/locuri-de-munca/locuri_de_munca/271987/Aleph-News/Editor-imagine-TV-Junior", "company": "Aleph News", "company_logo": "https://www.hipo.ro/public/resources/imagini/logofirma/2c6ffa6342ae5a07e472761dc23db11e.jpg", "location_text": "BUCURESTI", "cities": [ "BUCURESTI" ], "nationwide": false, "work_mode": null, "salary_text": "4000 - 5000 RON NET / luna", "salary_min": 4000, "salary_max": 5000, "salary_currency": "RON", "salary_type": "NET", "salary_period": "luna", "date_updated": "2026-11-10", "apply_without_cv": false, "company_id": null, "company_url": null, "domains": [], "job_type": null, "experience_level": null, "date_posted": null, "work_hours": null, "country": null, "company_description": null, "requirements": null, "responsibilities": null, "other_info": null, "benefits": [], "description_html": null, "description_text": null, "apply_url": null, "apply_methods": [], "details_fetched": false, "search_query": "all jobs", "source": "hipo.ro", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z" } ``` This is a row of a normal run: the job page columns stay null or empty. With `includeDetails` on, they are filled as well. Example of those columns (text shortened): ```json { "company_id": "112", "company_url": "https://www.hipo.ro/locuri-de-munca/vizualizareFirma/112/Accenture", "domains": [ "Customer support - Client service" ], "job_type": "full-time", "experience_level": "1 - 5 ani experienta", "date_posted": "2026-11-10", "work_hours": 40, "country": "Romania", "company_description": "Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping the world’s top businesses, governments, and organizations build their digital core...", "requirements": "Required Qualifications\n• German & English - B2-C1.\n• Minimum high school diploma. ...", "responsibilities": "Job location: Bucharest, Brasov, Iasi | Hybrid | 09:00-18:00 ...", "other_info": "Employee Benefits - Be well, work well, live well ...", "benefits": [ "Bonus de performanta", "Asigurare medicala", "Asigurare de viata", "..." ], "description_html": "

Scurta descriere a companiei

Accenture is a leading global ...", "description_text": "Scurta descriere a companiei\nAccenture is a leading global ...", "apply_url": "https://www.hipo.ro/locuri-de-munca/login?redirect=/locuri-de-munca/locuri_de_munca/273765/", "apply_methods": [ "Aplica la acest anunt", "Aplica cu LinkedIn", "Aplica cu Facebook" ] } ``` ## Fields The columns marked "Filled only when includeDetails is on" are null or empty in a normal run. | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric id of the job: the number in the job address /locuri_de_munca///. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the ad. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job page on hipo.ro. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company as shown on the ad. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the company. | | `location_text` | string, null | The place line of the ad as shown: cities separated by commas, or Hybrid or Remote. | | `cities` | array | The cities of the ad, one entry each. Empty for a Hybrid or Remote ad, whose place line names no city (in detail mode the job page cities fill it). | | `nationwide` | boolean | True when the ad is open nationwide (Job national). | | `work_mode` | string, null | Hybrid or Remote when the ad says so, otherwise null. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as shown on the ad. Most ads do not show a salary. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound of the salary, number. One amount gives the same value in min and max. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound of the salary, number. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | Currency code as shown (RON, EUR). | | `salary_type` | string, null | NET or BRUT (net or gross) as shown. | | `salary_period` | string, null | Pay period as shown, for example luna (month). | | `date_updated` | string, null | Date shown on the ad (the last update), ISO 8601. | | `apply_without_cv` | boolean | True when the ad carries the Aplica fara CV badge. | | `company_id` | string, null | Numeric id of the company on hipo.ro. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `company_url` | string, null | Page of the company on hipo.ro. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `domains` | array | Fields of work of the ad (Domeniu). Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `job_type` | string, null | Type of the job (Tip job), for example full-time. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `experience_level` | string, null | Level of the job (Nivel job), for example 1 - 5 ani experienta. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date from the job page data, ISO 8601. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `work_hours` | number, null | Weekly hours from the job page data. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `country` | string, null | Country the ad is open to, from the job page data. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `company_description` | string, null | The Scurta descriere a companiei section. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `requirements` | string, null | The Cerinte section as text. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `responsibilities` | string, null | The Responsabilitati section as text. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `other_info` | string, null | The Alte informatii section as text. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `benefits` | array | The Beneficii list, one entry each. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `description_html` | string, null | All sections of the job page as HTML, with a heading for each. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `description_text` | string, null | All sections of the job page as plain text. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `apply_url` | string, null | The apply address of the ad on hipo.ro (the site asks for a login). Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `apply_methods` | array | The apply buttons of the job page. Filled only when includeDetails is on. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The filters of the search that found the job, or all jobs. | | `source` | string | Site host. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time of the scrape, ISO 8601 UTC. | ## Limits - There is no keyword search in this version. The site's keyword search is a form that is not read here; use domains, cities and experience levels. - Most ads do not show a salary. Then the salary columns are `null`. - The list shows one date per ad, the last update (`date_updated`). The posting date (`date_posted`) comes with the job page. - The apply buttons of the site lead to its login page; the apply address is returned as it is. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each ad in the dataset. You are never charged for an ad twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [eJobs.ro Scraper: Romania Jobs, Salaries & Employers](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/ejobs-ro-scraper): Romanian general job board eJobs.ro with salaries and employers. - [ANOFM.ro Scraper: Romania Government Jobs & Vacancies](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/anofm-ro-scraper): Romanian public employment agency vacancies from ANOFM.ro. - [e-fellows.net Scraper - DACH Elite Graduate Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/e-fellows-scraper): Graduate and student jobs from e-fellows.net. - [WayUp Scraper: US Intern & Entry-Level Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/wayup-us-scraper): Internships and entry-level jobs from WayUp. ## FAQ **Can I search by keyword?** Not in this version. Filter by domain, city and experience level, then filter the rows on the title in your own tool. **Which filters can I combine?** All of them. Several values of one filter, for example two cities, are read together in one search. **Why do some ads have no city?** Hybrid and remote ads show Hybrid or Remote instead of a city on the list. Then `work_mode` is set, `cities` is empty and `location_text` holds the text of the site. With `includeDetails` on, the cities of the job page fill `cities`. **What happens when nothing matches?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for <filters>." and nothing is charged. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/hipo-ro-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
